extracted.name: One-Minute Hollandaise Sauce
extracted.description: This simple Hollandaise sauce made with melted butter, egg yolks, lemon juice, milk, salt, and pepper cooks in the microwave in just one minute!
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup butter, melted and slightly cooled
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Whisk egg yolks, lemon juice, milk, salt, and pepper together in a microwave-safe bowl. Whisk in melted butter, a little at a time, until smooth.
Cook in the microwave on medium power in 15-second intervals, whisking after each interval, until sauce is thick and hot, about 1 minute.
